decision: Build Decision Gate: a bounded adversarial decision ledger with deterministic stopping, controlled reopening, and outcome scoring

claims.title: Termination is the missing control boundary
claims.statement: A useful adversarial decision system must know when additional analysis has stopped changing the action.

claims.title: The final action should be deterministic
claims.statement: ACT, WAIT, or ABANDON should be computed from unresolved challenge materiality rather than generated by another model.

claims.title: Outcome scoring can calibrate later decisions
claims.statement: Recording later real-world outcomes against the original claims and accepted risks can reveal which reasoning patterns were reliable.

challenges.title: Prospective scoring needs enough resolved decisions
challenges.argument: Outcome calibration has little empirical value until the system accumulates a meaningful set of real decisions with observed results.
challenges.resolves_if: Accumulate and resolve at least 10 real decisions, then inspect whether the retrospective scoring is informative.

termination.reason: Latest round produced no new MATERIAL, BLOCKING, or FATAL challenge.

reasons: No fatal or blocking unresolved challenges remain.
accepted_risks: Prospective scoring needs enough resolved decisions
